    Lemma 9.2: the centralizer ray algebra B_χ #

    lem:centralizer-ray-algebra (integral-partial-lifts.tex). The centralizer C_χ = Cent_{A₀}(q̂) is spanned by the identities, the two-sided rays and the unshiftable rays; B_χ = C_χ/𝔞_χ has basis the supporting identities and the two-sided rays, with the products of A₀ (zero when the product leaves the basis). We record these as ray tables Tc (the centralizer) and Qχ (the two-sided table) with morphisms Tc → P (inclusion) and Tc → Qχ (quotient), and the projection π : kP → kQχ.

    Data for a sub-table: selected vertices and rays, closed enough for associativity.

    • pV : V → Prop
    • pR : R → Prop
    • e_mem (x : V) : self.pV x → self.pR (P.e x)
    • src_mem (r : R) : self.pR r → self.pV (P.src r)
    • tgt_mem (r : R) : self.pR r → self.pV (P.tgt r)
    • cc (r s u t v w : R) : self.pR r → self.pR s → self.pR u → P.mul r s = some t → P.mul t u = some w → P.mul s u = some v → self.pR w → (self.pR t ↔ self.pR v)
